summary: Wing Yip Food Holdings Group Ltd (a Cayman Islands company listed on the Korea Exchange) filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of a private placement of 23,000,000 new ordinary shares at KRW 1,600 per share, raising KRW 36.8 billion (approx. HKD 194.7 million) from Wang Tingfeng, Wong Sio Chan, and Zhao Jin Hua. The shares were issued on August 7, 2026, and listed on the KRX on September 7, 2026. Following issuance, total shares outstanding are 35,582,732. The new shares rank pari passu with existing shares and are subject to a one-year lock-up (September 7, 2026 to September 6, 2027). Proceeds are for working capital, including procurement, marketing, and R&D.
